description: This file defines an interface `CipherMethod` in the Aws\Crypto\Cipher namespace, specifying methods that crypto cipher implementations should implement, including obtaining cipher names, initialization vectors, padding requirements, seeking, and updating.

classes.name: CipherMethod
classes.description: An interface for cipher methods used in AWS crypto encryption, specifying methods for retrieving cipher details, managing IVs, and processing cipher blocks.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an identifier recognizable by openssl_* functions, such as 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES recognized name like 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the initialization vector (IV) used for the next encryption/decryption block.

methods.name: requiresPadding
methods.description: Indicates whether padding is required for the cipher method with the current IV.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Adjusts the IV in case of seeking within the encryption stream, possibly throwing a LogicException if seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the IV based on the last ciphertext block to maintain proper IV state after processing.
